summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline with domain-relevant features and uses 5-fold cross-validation to train an ensemble of gradient boosted trees. However, it applies a naive equal-weight ensemble, calculates imputation statistics before the cross-validation split (causing mild data leakage between folds), and entirely fails to compute or report any validation scores.
